attr.title: Titanic: Adventure Out of Time
attr.desc: Godot player for the original game. Supply your own prepared cd1 and cd2 game data. Optional M3tox mods are supported.
attr.inst: Copy prepared cd1 and cd2 into ports/titanic/gamedata. See README.txt. Left stick moves; right stick controls the mouse; A clicks; L1 slows the pointer; Start opens the menu.
